The state of being strict and right.

rigidness.definitionKo: 말, 태도, 규칙 등이 매우 엄하고 철저함.
rigidness.englishDescription: A state of being very strict and thorough in words, attitude, rules, etc.

robot.definitionKo: 사람의 전체 모습이나 몸의 한 부위와 비슷하게 만들어서 사람이 하는 행동이나 작업 등을 할 수 있도록 만든 기계.
robot.englishDescription: A machine shaped like the entire human figure or part of the body to act as humans do or do what they do.

robot.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 줏대 없이 남이 시키는 대로 움직이는 사람.
robot.englishDescription: (figurative) A person who acts only as told to by others instead of acting on his own will.

robot.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 자신의 생각이나 의지와는 상관없이 행동하는 사람.
robot.englishDescription: (figurative) A person who acts independent of his/her thoughts or will.

robot.definitionKo: 인간과 비슷한 모습을 하고 움직이기도 하고 말도 하는 기계.
robot.englishDescription: A machine that looks, speaks and behaves like a human.

robot.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 자기의 생각이나 의견 없이 남이 시키는 대로 행동하는 사람.
robot.englishDescription: (figurative) A person who acts as he/she is told to do without his/her own thought or opinion.

robot.definitionKo: (놀리는 말로) 능력이나 자기의 주장이 있는 의견이 전혀 없는 사람.
robot.englishDescription: (teasing) A person who does not have any ability or ideas or opinions of his/her own.

sanitary.definitionKo: 건강에 이롭거나 도움이 되도록 조건을 갖춘.
sanitary.englishDescription: Meeting criteria to be beneficial to or good for health.

satisfy.englishDescription: To follow or comply with required procedures or formalities.
To meet one's expectations, demands, etc.
To treat someone kindly and carefully.

satisfy.definitionKo: 일정한 기준이나 분량을 채워 모자람이 없게 하다.
satisfy.englishDescription: To meet a certain condition or reach a certain quantity, making sure that there is no shortage.

satisfy.definitionKo: 기대하거나 필요한 것이 부족함 없거나 마음에 들어 흐뭇하게 하다.
satisfy.englishDescription: To please someone with something expected or needed  that has been achieved completely or is satisfactory.

satisfy.definitionKo: 일정한 기준이나 분량을 채워 모자람이 없게 하다.
satisfy.englishDescription: To meet a certain condition or reach a certain quantity, so that there is no shortage.

scandal.definitionKo: 남녀 간의 애정 관계에 관한 소문.
scandal.englishDescription: A rumor about a love affair between a man and a woman.

scandal.definitionKo: 매우 충격적이고 부도덕한 사건. 또는 매우 부끄러운 평판이나 소문.
scandal.englishDescription: An extremely shocking, immoral incident, or an extremely humiliating reputation or rumor.

scandal.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 어떤 일에 대해 도는 좋지 않은 말이나 소문.
scandal.englishDescription: (figurative) Words or rumors that go around about a certain affair.
A humiliating rumor or reputation, usually about an immoral behavior.

scatter.englishDescription: To put things here and there disorderedly.

scatter.definitionKo: 모여 있던 것들이 따로따로 흩어지거나 떨어지다.
scatter.englishDescription: For something stuck together to fall apart or scatter.

scatter.definitionKo: 모여 있던 것들이 따로따로 흩어지거나 떨어지다.
scatter.englishDescription: For something stuck together to fall apart or scatter.

scatter.definitionKo: 한데 모였던 것이 따로따로 떨어지거나 여러 곳으로 퍼지다.
scatter.englishDescription: For something stuck together to fall apart separately or spread out in all directions.
To scatter things and make them entangled in a disorderly manner.
To scatter and blow; or to make this happen.
For something stuck together to fall apart separately.

school.definitionKo: 지식이나 기술 등을 가르쳐 익히게 하는 곳.
school.englishDescription: A place that teaches and enables one to learn knowledge or techniques, etc.
A place for accumulating knowledge, learning skills, etc.

school.definitionKo: 돈을 내 주어 학교나 학원에서 공부하게 하다.
school.englishDescription: To put someone through a school or an institute by paying for his/her education.

school.definitionKo: 주로 학계나 예술계에서, 생각이나 경향이 비슷한 사람들끼리 모여서 이룬 무리.
school.englishDescription: In the fields of academy or art, the group consisting of people of similar thoughts or tendencies.

school.definitionKo: 학문이나 예술 등에서 뛰어난 능력이 있어 경지에 오르거나 독자적인 체계를 이룬 상태.
school.englishDescription: A state in which one has an excellent ability in a field of study, art, etc., and thus has become a master or established one's own system.

school.definitionKo: 일정한 목적, 교과 과정, 제도 등에 따라 학생을 교육하는 기관.
school.englishDescription: An institution that educates students according to a specific purpose, curriculum, system, etc.

school.definitionKo: 일정한 목적, 교과 과정, 제도 등에 따라 학생을 교육하는 기관.
school.englishDescription: An institution that educates students according to a specific purpose, curriculum, system, etc.

school.definitionKo: 어떤 사상이나 행동이 계속 이어져 내려오는 것.
school.englishDescription: An idea or practice that has been passed on continuously.

school.definitionKo: 대학에서 전공 영역에 따라 몇 개의 관련 학과를 묶어 만든 부.
school.englishDescription: An academic division within a college or university, created by joining several related departments together.
A school or campus at which one studies.

school.definitionKo: 학문적 주장이나 견해가 같거나 비슷한 사람들의 집단.
school.englishDescription: A group of people who share a common or similar academic opinion or view.

scrum.definitionKo: 여러 사람이 서로 팔을 끼거나 어깨동무를 해서 하나로 뭉치는 것.
scrum.englishDescription: Many people locking arm-in-arm, or putting arms around each other's shoulders and becoming one.

secretion.definitionKo: 세포에서 만들어진 액체를 세포 밖으로 내보내는 것.
secretion.englishDescription: The process of releasing liquid produced in a cell.

secretion.definitionKo: 분비 과정에서 나오는 침이나 땀 등의 물질.
secretion.englishDescription: A substance produced in a secretory process, such as saliva and sweat.

segregation.definitionKo: 다른 것과 서로 통하지 못하게 사이를 막거나 떼어 놓음.
segregation.englishDescription: Blocking or separating someone from others to hinder communication.

sem.englishDescription: A bound noun indicating certain circumstances or results.
A bound noun indicating a plan to do something.
A bound noun indicating judgment by guessing.

semifinal.definitionKo: 결승전에 나갈 자격을 겨루는 시합이나 경기.
semifinal.englishDescription: A game or match to determine who will be qualified to advance to the final.

semifinal.definitionKo: 결승전에 나갈 자격을 겨루는 시합이나 경기.
semifinal.englishDescription: A game or match to determine who will be qualified to advance to the final.

sentry.definitionKo: 부대의 경계선이나 여러 출입문에서 경계와 감시를 하는 병사.
sentry.englishDescription: A soldier who stays on alert and keeps watch, being stationed at the military unit's border or different gates.

sentry.definitionKo: 초소를 지키며 경계와 감시를 하는 병사.
sentry.englishDescription: A soldier who stays on alert and keeps watch, usually stationed at a sentry post.

seonbi.englishDescription: scholar: (archaic) A person who pursues learning.

seonbi.definitionKo: (옛날에) 벼슬을 하지 않고 학문에만 힘쓴 사람.
seonbi.englishDescription: (archaic) Literally, a virtuous scholar, a person who only pursues learning without holding a government post.

seonbi.definitionKo: 학식과 절개가 있고 성품이 바르며 권력이나 재물에 욕심내지 않는 사람.
seonbi.englishDescription: A person who is learned, loyal, and honest, and has no desire for power or wealth.

seoul.definitionKo: 한반도 중앙에 있는 특별시. 한국의 수도이자 정치, 경제, 산업, 사회, 문화, 교통의 중심지이다. 북한산, 관악산 등의 산에 둘러싸여 있고 가운데로는 한강이 흐른다.
seoul.englishDescription: A metropolitan city located in the center of the Korean Peninsula, it is the capital of the Republic of Korea and the center of the country's politics, business, society, culture and transportation. It is surrounded by mountains such as Bukhansan Mountain and Gwanaksan Mountain and crossed by the Hangang River.

shampoo.definitionKo: 머리를 감는 데 쓰는 액체 비누.
shampoo.englishDescription: Liquid soap used for washing one's hair.

shining.definitionKo: 눈에 바르고 맑은 기운이 있어서 또렷하다.
shining.englishDescription: Clear and bright eyes filled with sound spirit and vitality.

shipyard.englishDescription: A place where ships are built or fixed.

shortcoming.definitionKo: 다른 사람에 비해 부족해서 불리한 점.
shortcoming.englishDescription: A thing that one lacks compared to others, being a disadvantage.
A trait of one's personality that is defective or not admirable.

shortcoming.definitionKo: 미처 생각하지 못하고 지나친 허점이나 틈.
shortcoming.englishDescription: A weak point not considered and overlooked.

shortcoming.definitionKo: 사람의 성격, 말, 행동 등에 나타나는 부족한 점.
shortcoming.englishDescription: A deficiency in one's character, words, action, etc.

sipda.definitionKo: 앞말이 나타내는 내용을 하고자 하는 의도나 욕구가 있음을 나타내는 말.
sipda.englishDescription: An auxiliary adjective used to indicate that the speaker has an intention or desire to do what the preceding statement describes.

sipda.definitionKo: 앞말이 나타내는 내용과 같은 느낌이 들거나 앞의 내용과 같이 생각됨을 나타내는 말.
sipda.englishDescription: An auxiliary adjective used to indicate what the preceding statement describes is the speaker's impression or thought.

sipda.definitionKo: 앞말이 나타내는 내용대로 될까 봐 걱정하는 마음이 있음을 나타내는 말.
sipda.englishDescription: An auxiliary adjective used to indicate that the speaker is anxious that what the preceding statement describes might become reality.

sipda.definitionKo: 앞말이 나타내는 내용이 이루어지기를 바라거나 앞의 행동을 할 생각이 있음을 나타내는 말.
sipda.englishDescription: An auxiliary adjective used to indicate that the speaker hopes what the preceding statement describes will be realized or has an intention to do it.

sipda.definitionKo: 앞말이 나타내는 행동을 할 생각이 막연하게 있음을 나타내는 말.
sipda.englishDescription: An auxiliary adjective used to indicate that the speaker has a vague intention to do what the preceding statement describes.

slender.definitionKo: 몸, 팔, 다리 등이 가늘고 연약하다.
slender.englishDescription: A person's body, arms, legs, etc., being thin and weak.
One's body being thin and weak.

slender.definitionKo: 몸이 가늘고 키가 커서 맵시가 있다.
slender.englishDescription: Having a thin body, being tall, and thus looking stylish.

slender.definitionKo: 모양이 아주 날씬해서 매끈하고 맵시가 있다.
slender.englishDescription: A shape being very slim, sleek, and stylish.
A person's body being attractively slim and tall.

slender.definitionKo: 길이가 있는 물건의 몸통의 굵기가 가늘고 작다.
slender.englishDescription: A long object being thin and small.
One's body being thin and slim.
The body of an object being thin and long compared to its length.

snowboard.definitionKo: 납작한 판 위에 올라서서 눈이 덮인 비탈을 미끄러져 내려오는 운동. 또는 그 운동에 쓰는 판.
snowboard.englishDescription: A sport in which one stands on a flat board and slides down a slope covered with snow, or a board used in such a sport.

solicitor.definitionKo: (속된 말로) 물건 등을 팔기 위해 길에서 손님을 잡아끄는 사람.
solicitor.englishDescription: (slang) A person who solicits customers on the street to sell goods, etc.

sophistication.definitionKo: 꾸미거나 표현하는 솜씨가 아주 훌륭한 것.
sophistication.englishDescription: Being excellent in the skills connected to decoration or expression.

sophistication.definitionKo: 말이나 글, 행동 등이 서투르거나 어색하지 않고 훌륭하고 능숙함.
sophistication.englishDescription: Skillful, clever speech, writing, behavior, etc., that is not clumsy or awkward.

sophistication.definitionKo: 어떤 것이 서투르거나 어색한 느낌 없이 훌륭하고 능숙한 데서 느껴지는 맛.
sophistication.englishDescription: The beauty found in skillfulness and cleverness, without being awkward or clumsy.

speechless.definitionKo: 말할 자리에서 어떤 말이나 반응이 없고 무표정하다.
speechless.englishDescription: Remaining still without any word, response, or facial expression, when one is expected to say something.

ssam.definitionKo: 밥이나 고기, 반찬 등을 상추, 깻잎 등의 채소에 싸서 먹는 음식.
ssam.englishDescription: Leaf wraps and rice, eaten after wrapping rice, meat, and other side dishes in leaves of lettuce, sesame, etc.

ssanggiyeok.englishDescription: The name of the consonant 'ㄲ' in the Korean alphabet.

ssanghwatang.definitionKo: 몸의 기운을 보충하기 위하여 여러 가지 약초를 넣고 끓인 한약.
ssanghwatang.englishDescription: Herb tonic tea, made by boiling various herbs in water, which replenishes one's energy.

staple.definitionKo: 밥이나 빵과 같이 끼니에 주가 되는 음식.
staple.englishDescription: A main food in meals such as steamed rice or bread.

steak.definitionKo: 고기를 두툼하고 크게 썰어서 굽거나 지진 서양 요리.
steak.englishDescription: A Western dish in which meat is cut into thick, large pieces and grilled or fried.

stern.definitionKo: 말, 태도, 규칙 등이 매우 엄하고 철저하다.
stern.englishDescription: Being very strict and thorough in one's speech, attitude, rules, etc.

stern.definitionKo: 남의 처지를 살피지 않고 규칙을 적용하는 것이 확실하며 빈틈없다.
stern.englishDescription: Applying rules in a clear and thorough way without considering others' situation.

stern.definitionKo: 규칙을 적용하거나 예절을 가르치는 일 등이 매우 철저하고 바르다.
stern.englishDescription: Thorough and upright in applying a rule or teaching manners.
One's personality or behavior being very thorough and fastidious.

stern.definitionKo: 호령이나 호통이 위엄이 있고 아주 대단하다.
stern.englishDescription: One's command or scolding having dignity and being very loud.

sternly.englishDescription: With an upright and stubborn personality.

sternly.definitionKo: 성격이나 태도 등이 고분고분하지 않고 딱딱하게.
sternly.englishDescription: A word describing one having a stiff and unkind personality or attitude, instead of one pleasing to others.

sternly.definitionKo: 성격이나 태도 등이 고분고분하지 않고 딱딱하다.
sternly.englishDescription: Having a stiff and unkind personality or attitude, instead of one pleasing to others.

sternly.definitionKo: 말, 태도, 규칙 등이 매우 엄하고 철저하게.
sternly.englishDescription: In a manner of being very strict and thorough in one's speech, attitude, rules, etc.

stipulation.definitionKo: 내용, 성격, 의미 등을 분명하게 정함. 또는 그렇게 정해 놓은 것.
stipulation.englishDescription: The act of deciding content, principles, meanings clearly; or things that have been decided in such a manner.

stipulation.definitionKo: 계약 등의 어떤 일을 약속하여 정함.
stipulation.englishDescription: The act of settling something such as a contract, etc.

stone-throwing.definitionKo: 무엇을 맞히기 위해 돌멩이를 던지는 짓.
stone-throwing.englishDescription: The act of throwing stones at something.

stone-throwing.definitionKo: 무엇을 맞히기 위해 세차게 던지는 작은 돌.
stone-throwing.englishDescription: The violent throwing of small stones at something.

stone-throwing.definitionKo: 무엇을 맞히기 위해 작은 돌을 세차게 던지는 일.
stone-throwing.englishDescription: The act of violently throwing stones at someone or something.
An act of throwing a stone, or such a stone.

strengthening.englishDescription: The act of causing power or force to be stronger.

strengthening.definitionKo: 바탕이 되는 것을 튼튼하고 확실하게 하는 일.
strengthening.englishDescription: The act of strengthening and solidifying the foundation.
The act of strengthening the body and mind.

sufficient.definitionKo: 크기나 수 등이 적거나 부족하지 않고 충분하다.
sufficient.englishDescription: Enough, neither small nor insufficient in size or number.

sufficient.definitionKo: 살림살이나 옷, 음식 등이 제대로 갖추어져 충분하다.
sufficient.englishDescription: Having a sufficient amount of good household items, clothing, food, etc.
One's household size or income being enough and substantial.
There being plenty and no shortage.

sufficient.definitionKo: 일정한 기준이나 정도에 모자람 없이 충분하다.
sufficient.englishDescription: Adequate in level or amount without lacking.

sumuk.definitionKo: 먹으로 진하고 연한 효과를 내어 그린 그림.
sumuk.englishDescription: ink wash painting: A painting done in varying shades of black, using the ink from a black ink stone.

swimming.definitionKo: 사람이나 물고기 등이 물속에서 나아가기 위해 팔다리나 지느러미를 움직이는 일.
swimming.englishDescription: A person or fish's moving his/her or its arms and legs to go forward in water.

their.definitionKo: 듣는 사람 또는 듣는 사람들을 가리키는 말.
their.englishExpression: their; they; his; her; he; she
their.englishDescription: A pronoun used to indicate the listener or listeners.

their.definitionKo: 듣는 사람과 듣는 사람을 포함한 여러 사람을 가리키는 말.
their.englishDescription: A pronoun used to indicate many people including the listener.

their.definitionKo: 말하는 사람과 듣는 사람이 이미 알고 있는 사람을 가리키는 말.
their.englishExpression: their; they; his; her; he; she
their.englishDescription: A pronoun used to indicate a person who the speaker and listener already know.

their.definitionKo: 듣는 사람 또는 듣는 사람들을 가리키는 말.
their.englishExpression: their; they; his; her; he; she
their.englishDescription: A pronoun used to indicate the listener or listeners.

toupee.definitionKo: 진짜 머리카락처럼 만들어 머리에 쓰거나 붙이는 가짜 머리카락.
toupee.englishDescription: Fake hair worn over or attached to one's own hair using clips, etc.

toxicity.englishDescription: A poisonous content or such characteristics.

toxicity.definitionKo: 먹거나 몸에 닿으면 목숨이 위태롭게 되거나 몸에 이상을 일으키는 성질.
toxicity.englishDescription: The quality of a substance killing or harming a person when he/she consumes or touches it.

traitor.definitionKo: 국가와 민족, 또는 그와 비슷한 권력을 가진 조직에 대한 의리를 저버리고 배신한 사람.
traitor.englishDescription: A person who turns his/her back on a nation, people or any organization that has a similar power, abandoning the duty of loyalty to such entities.

traitor.definitionKo: 사람들과의 관계에서 지켜야 할 믿음과 의리에 어긋나게 행동한 사람.
traitor.englishDescription: A person who acts against trust and loyalty that he/she is expected to maintain in a relationship.
A person who betrayed the other side's trust and fidelity.

traitor.definitionKo: 국가에 반역하는 일을 돕거나 함께 한 사람.
traitor.englishDescription: A person who has helped or joined a rebellion against a government.
A person who has betrayed his/her country or ruler.

tranquilizer.englishDescription: A medicine taken to calm one's anxiety, etc.

tranquilizer.definitionKo: 신경에 작용하여 불안, 긴장 등의 흥분을 가라앉히는 약물.
tranquilizer.englishDescription: A medicine taken to reduce anxiety, tension, etc., by calming one's nerves.

travel.definitionKo: 한 곳에서 다른 곳으로 장소를 이동하다.
travel.englishDescription: To move from one place to another place.
To travel through a certain route.

travel.definitionKo: 집을 떠나 다른 지방이나 나라를 두루 구경하며 다니는 일.
travel.englishDescription: The act of leaving home and traveling around other regions or countries.

travel.definitionKo: 집을 떠나 다른 지방이나 나라를 두루 구경하며 다니다.
travel.englishDescription: To leave home and travel around other regions or countries.

travel.definitionKo: 한 곳에서 다른 곳으로 옮겨 가다.
travel.englishDescription: To shift from a place to another.

travel.definitionKo: 어떤 사실이나 소식을 알아내기 위해 사람이나 장소를 찾아가다.
travel.englishDescription: To visit a place or a person to find out a certain fact or news.

travel.englishExpression: visit; travel; go on a field trip
travel.englishDescription: To visit a tourist attraction or historic site to look around.

travel.definitionKo: 나이가 많거나 지위가 높은 사람이 차리고 나서서 길을 가다.
travel.englishDescription: For a person who is older or higher in ranking to get dressed up and set off a trip to a certain place.
For a sound or smell, etc., to come from a certain place and spread.

trinity.definitionKo: 각각 다른 세 가지가 하나의 목적을 위해 하나로 합쳐지는 일.
trinity.englishDescription: A state in which three different things become united for a single purpose.

tum-tum.definitionKo: 북이나 장구 등을 흥겹게 두드리는 소리.
tum-tum.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when beating the buk, a barrel drum, or janggu, an hourglass-shaped traditional Korean musical instrument, etc., lively.

tum-tum.definitionKo: 북이나 장구 등을 계속 두드리는 소리.
tum-tum.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when beating the buk, a barrel drum, or janggu, an hourglass-shaped traditional Korean musical instrument, etc., repeatedly.

udon.definitionKo: 면발이 굵은 국수. 또는 그것을 삶아서 국물과 함께 요리한 음식.
udon.englishDescription: Thick stripes of noodles, or a soup made by boiling them.

undamaged.definitionKo: 바뀌거나 달라지는 것이나 아무 사고 없이 온전하게.
undamaged.englishDescription: Intact, in perfect condition without having been affected by changes or accidents.

underclassman.englishDescription: A student in a lower class in school.

underdrawing.definitionKo: 만화 등의 상업용 미술에서 소유권이나 캐릭터가 없는 단순한 그림.
underdrawing.englishDescription: A simple picture without the right of ownership or characters in commercial art such as cartoons, etc.

undergarment.definitionKo: 추위를 막기 위해 옷 속에 껴입는 옷.
undergarment.englishDescription: The clothes worn over other clothes to protect oneself from cold.

uneasily.englishDescription: In the state of being nervous and anxious.
In such a manner that someone does not feel at ease but anxious.

utilization.definitionKo: 대상을 필요에 따라 이롭거나 쓸모가 있게 씀.
utilization.englishDescription: The act of using something as occasion demands in a way that is helpful or beneficial to one.

utilization.definitionKo: 어떤 대상이 가지고 있는 쓰임이나 능력을 충분히 잘 이용함.
utilization.englishDescription: An act of making full use of a function or ability possessed by a certain object.

vacate.englishDescription: To make a situation in which no one remains in a certain place.

vacate.definitionKo: 셋방 등과 같이 빌려서 사는 곳을 비우다.
vacate.englishDescription: To vacate a leased residence like a rented home.

vaccinate.englishDescription: To have someone get an injection or treated with acupuncture.

vaccinate.definitionKo: 병의 예방, 치료, 진단, 실험 등을 위해 병원균이나 항독소, 항체 등을 사람이나 동물의 몸속에 넣다.
vaccinate.englishDescription: To inject germs, antitoxins, antibodies, etc., into the body of a human or animal for disease prevention, treatment, diagnosis, experiment, etc.

velvet.definitionKo: 짧고 부드러운 털이 촘촘히 돋아 있는 천.
velvet.englishDescription: Cloth dense with short, smooth pile.

voluntarism.definitionKo: 남의 가르침이나 영향에 의하지 않고, 자기 스스로의 생각과 판단에 의해 행동하는 성질.
voluntarism.englishDescription: The trait of behaving according to one's own thoughts and judgment without being swayed by others' teachings or influence.

well-grown.definitionKo: 나무, 풀, 머리털 등이 잘 자라서 알차고 길다.
well-grown.englishDescription: A tree, grass, hairs, etc., being dense, tall or long, due to having grown well.

witticism.definitionKo: 인생의 진리나 가르침을 담은 짧은 문장.
witticism.englishDescription: A short, clever sentence telling the truth or a lesson of life.

yardstick.englishDescription: A standard in measuring lengths with a ruler.
A standard used for judging or measuring.

yeast.definitionKo: 술을 빚거나 빵을 만들 때 쓰는 발효제.
yeast.englishDescription: A leavening agent used to brew alcoholic beverages or to bake bread.

yo.englishDescription: The name of the vowel 'ㅛ' in the Korean alphabet.

yo.definitionKo: 한글 자모의 스무째 글자. 이름은 ‘요’이고 중성으로 쓴다.
yo.englishDescription: The sixth vowel of the Korean alphabet pronounced 'yo' and used as a middle vowel letter.

yo.definitionKo: 높임의 대상인 상대방에게 존대의 뜻을 나타내는 조사.
yo.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used to indicate respect for the other person, the subject who is shown respect.

yo.definitionKo: 높임의 대상인 상대방에게 존대의 뜻을 나타내는 조사.
yo.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used to indicate respect for the other person, the subject who is shown respect.

you.definitionKo: (조금 높이는 말로) 듣는 사람을 가리키는 말.
you.englishDescription: (formal, slightly addressee-raising) A pronoun used to indicate the listener.

you.definitionKo: (낮잡아 이르는 말로) 듣는 사람을 가리키는 말.
you.englishDescription: (disparaging) A pronoun used to indicate the listener.

you.definitionKo: (아주 높이는 말로) 앞에서 이미 말한 사람을 도로 가리키는 말.
you.englishDescription: (formal, highly addressee-raising) A pronoun used to indicate the person mentioned earlier.
(polite form) A pronoun used to indicate the listener.

you.definitionKo: 듣는 사람이 친구나 아랫사람들일 때, 그 사람들을 가리키는 말.
you.englishDescription: A pronoun used to indicate the listeners when they are the same age or younger.

you.definitionKo: (높이는 말로) 듣는 사람이 대등한 관계에 있는 사람이나 아랫사람일 때, 그 사람을 가리키는 말.
you.englishDescription: (polite form) When a listener is on equal terms with or younger than the speaker, or a term that addresses that person.

you.definitionKo: (높이는 말로) 나이가 비슷하면서 잘 모르는 사람이나, 아랫사람을 가리키는 말.
you.englishDescription: (polite form) A word used to refer to a person who is similar to the speaker in age and the speaker is not acquainted with, or who is junior to the speaker.

you.definitionKo: 지도자나 통솔자가 여러 명의 아랫사람을 조금 높여 가리키는 말.
you.englishDescription: A somewhat honorific form of a word used by a leader or commander when calling a group of his/her subordinates.
A form of '너' (you), when the postpositional particle '가' is attached to it.

young.englishDescription: (figurative) Being full of youth and livelihood.

young.definitionKo: 동물이나 식물 등이 난 지 얼마 되지 않아 작고 약하다.
young.englishDescription: Small and weak because the animal or plant has recently been born or budded.

young.definitionKo: 보기에 나이가 실제 나이보다 적은 듯하다.
young.englishDescription: Looking younger than one actually is.
Having lived for only a short time.
